title: Proposed built-in Style screening
description: A matched-seed screen of ten proposed deterministic Style suffixes plus an unstyled control across two style-neutral scenes.

styles.name: HyperCard
styles.prompt_text: Rendered in an early Macintosh HyperCard visual style: pure black-and-white 1-bit bitmap artwork, hard pixel edges, dithered patterns for midtones, and sparse high-contrast linework.

styles.name: Cinematic Film
styles.prompt_text: Rendered as a cinematic live-action film still with naturalistic lens detail, nuanced color grading, rich shadow separation, motivated directional lighting, and subtle organic film grain.

styles.name: Isometric Game
styles.prompt_text: Rendered as stylized isometric game art with a consistent top-down isometric projection, clean geometric forms, simplified surfaces, bright readable colors, soft ambient shadows, and even illumination.

styles.name: Pixel Art
styles.prompt_text: Rendered as crisp 16-bit pixel art with grid-aligned hard-edged pixels, a limited color palette, flat color clusters, deliberate dithering, and pixel-scale shading.

styles.name: Watercolor Painting
styles.prompt_text: Rendered as a watercolor painting with translucent layered washes, visible pigment blooms, softly bleeding edges, luminous white paper, natural fiber texture, and loose expressive brushwork.
expected_characteristics: loose brushwork and softly bleeding edges

styles.name: Color Pencil
styles.prompt_text: Rendered as a colored-pencil drawing with visible layered strokes, waxy pigment texture, burnished highlights, fine hatching and crosshatching, vibrant color, and natural paper grain.

styles.name: Pencil Sketch
styles.prompt_text: Rendered as a graphite pencil sketch with expressive line weight, crosshatched and softly smudged tonal shading, erased highlights, monochrome graphite, and textured white paper.

styles.name: Glazed Ceramic
styles.prompt_text: Depicted as a hand-painted glazed ceramic diorama: smooth sculpted clay forms, saturated underglaze color, vitreous gloss, soft specular reflections, subtle glaze pooling, and handcrafted irregularities.
expected_characteristics: scene transformed into sculpted ceramic forms

styles.name: Graphic Novel
styles.prompt_text: Rendered as a graphic novel illustration with bold black ink contours, clean expressive linework, flat cel-shaded color, a controlled palette, hard-edged shadows, and dramatic tonal contrast.

styles.name: Miniature Toy
styles.prompt_text: Depicted as a handcrafted miniature toy diorama with painted resin figures and scenery, simplified tactile forms, fine model-making detail, soft studio illumination, and shallow macro-lens depth of field.

scenes.title: Island lighthouse
scenes.description: At dusk, a red-coated lighthouse keeper stands on a rocky island path. A tall white lighthouse rises behind her, a small blue rowboat is tied to a wooden dock on the left, and three gulls circle above the sea. The keeper, lighthouse, rowboat, dock, and gulls are all clearly visible.
composition_requirements: rowboat tied to the dock on the left

scenes.title: Clockmaker workshop
scenes.description: Inside a clockmaker's workshop, a brass telescope stands in the center. A tall blue cabinet with two closed doors is on the left, and a round window showing rain is on the right. A small orange cat sits beneath the telescope. The telescope, cabinet, window, and cat are all clearly visible.
